trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order, and save the long grinds — 100% completion, 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots — for the final stretch, because this pops the moment the last one lands.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so it pops in your first session as long as you play the story from the start instead of wandering off into free roam.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Play the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends and the next chapter begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Keep playing the story in order — nothing extra to do, the chapter trophy comes with the final mission of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Same rule as the other chapters: story first, in order, and the trophy follows the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale; keep the story moving and it pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the story finale, so it comes after Chapter 4. The mission's name and any endgame choice are not pinned down yet — play the story to the credits and this pops with the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it appears as you play through the story in order. The exact chapter it falls in is not pinned down yet — check your mission list as you go.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission; it comes up in the story order, so keep playing missions and it will arrive.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story mission; play in order and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story mission; it unlocks as you work through the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport (VCIA); play the story in order and it comes up.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission; keep playing the story in order.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one: it counts story, stranger missions, activities, collectibles and exploration together. Track it in the in-game stats and use the checklist here — every other trophy in this guide feeds into it, so treat it as the last gold before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts — they add up fast once you start chaining them in free roam. Pick a fast car, find long straights and ramps, and grind them in batches; the counter is in the stats, and the exact list of what counts as a stunt is not yet confirmed in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types — PSN's target is 9 — so sample one of each: a race, fishing, an arcade game, the shooting range, a drone race, meditation, bowling, and the rest as they appear. You only need to try each once, not master it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the range's weapons and drills. Learn each drill's gold time and score, practise the weak ones, and clear them one weapon at a time. The range locations and the exact drill list are not pinned down yet — check the range menu in-game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations. Win one race at each — learn the course, cut the corners, and don't be afraid to restart a race you are losing. The 14 locations are not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty different race events across the state — road, off-road and whatever else the race menu holds. You need 20 distinct wins, so vary the events rather than repeating one favourite. The full race list is not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing is timing and patience — watch the line, reel steady, and don't let the fish run the line out. Where Cal is found is not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and play a full game to the end. Any arcade game counts; pick the shortest one if you just want the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is a stranger contact; finish his whole mission strand and the trophy pops with his last mission. Do stranger strands as they appear so none is left for the endgame.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If a strand can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so finish stranger strands as they appear.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. There are more stranger contacts than the 8 you need, so pick the strands you enjoy and finish 8 of them end to end. The 5 named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the 8, so this overlaps with the stranger trophies.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_note: Story — earn it as you play. If the mission can't be replayed, it can't be earned later, so don't skip story missions.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots. Visit each one and meditate there — the spots are the quiet viewpoints scattered across the state, and the exact locations are not pinned down yet, so mark each one off as you find it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret wants one specific animal. Find the animal's habitat, track it, and take the shot cleanly — a unique animal won't offer the same chance twice, so make the first shot count. Which animal and where it roams are not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida in sets of three. Collect all three cards of any 3 sets. The card locations are not pinned down yet, so explore thoroughly and mark sets off as you complete them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game social and check-in app — open it at 100 different spots across Leonida. It is a grind of visiting places, so fold it into exploration: WAiNK at every new area you reach and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks scattered through the game — stunts, driving feats and more. Fifty of them, of any kind, so just play widely and the counter fills. The full challenge list is not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search until the wanted level clears. Use the alleys and the water to break the search, and don't let your partner get caught.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob one shop, move straight to the next with your partner, and do it three times in a row without the wanted level dropping. Plan a route of three close shops, keep a fast getaway car ready, and don't stop to fight.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles — every new model you get into counts. Steal, borrow and test-drive widely; the vehicle list is long, so this fills up naturally if you never drive the same car twice.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-mo aim mode. Activate it in a fight with at least 5 enemies close together and drop all five before it runs out. Pick a crowded firefight, aim for headshots, and don't waste the window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a stunt at Vice City International Airport — leave the airport in a way the departures board didn't plan, most likely a jump or a runway exit in a fast vehicle. The exact spot is not pinned down yet; try the runway ends and the service roads.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and make it count — the trophy is tied to doing something memorable in one, most likely causing chaos or surviving a fight in it. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet; take a Rhino out and stir up trouble.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan it quiet: go in off-hours, avoid the cameras and the staff's sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending with a clean escape. Plan each one — entry, vault, getaway — and don't rush; a failed escape means the vault doesn't count. The five vault locations are not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and escape before the police close in. Trucks run set routes, so learn one, ambush it somewhere quiet, and have a fast car waiting.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 named areas to visit across the state — cities, towns, swamps, beaches and backroads. Drive everywhere, and check the map for the areas you haven't touched; the 52-area list is not pinned down yet, so explore widely and mark them off.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs, each running an illegal operation somewhere in Leonida. Hit one operation per gang — nine hits in total. The gangs and their operations are not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missable_note: Story moment — do it when the game offers it; don't rush past the beachfront.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the Ocean Beach spot with the view, order the cocktail and take it in. It reads like a story moment, so do it when the game offers it — don't rush past the beachfront. The exact spot is not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass and out the other side, the way the old games did it. Pick a showroom, build speed, and don't brake.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper game — follow through on the throw, don't just mess around. Any full game counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is about your partnership — build it up until it hits the mark the trophy wants. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet; keep doing partner activities and it will come.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: Choices lock in — think before you pick; some choices can't be undone.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make 500 choices across the game — dialogue and action choices that shape how things play out. They add up over a full playthrough, so don't skip conversations and cutscenes; the counter is in the stats, and some choices may lock in, so think before you pick.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: A one-time retry window — take the retry, don't reload an old save.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then get it right the second time — this is the retry trophy. The exact event is not pinned down yet; if you fail a mission or a challenge, take the retry instead of reloading an old save.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: A one-off event — be there when it happens; it may not come around again.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange happens in Leonida — a one-off event. When it happens, be there and see it through. The event itself is not pinned down yet, so keep an eye out for the odd and the unexplained as you explore.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive by the bowling alley and take the pins down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Line the car up with the pins, swing as you pass, and mind the timing — speed helps, accuracy matters more.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts a little at a time until $250,000 is clean. Keep robbing and laundering in parallel — the counter is in the stats.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, cars and upgrades until $100,000 is spent in shops. It adds up fast once you start kitting out, so spend as you earn rather than saving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida. Save up, buy them one by one, and the trophy pops with the eighth. The 8 locations are not pinned down yet.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles worth keeping, register each one in the Scooter Bros app, and the trophy pops at ten. Any ten vehicles count — grab the interesting ones as you find them.
